descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S12 Day 1 → reopen 20 h later (Hospital): the full day-2 checklist

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Day-2 reopen (Hospital, 20 h after today's note): the pre-round box is empty (12 h) and the Important Points are gone (12 h). (UAT TC-13; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-92591 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U6 Day-2 reopen (Hospital, 20 h): yesterday's encounter and note are gone from the working tabs (18 h). They are still present as yesterday's transcript and, read-only, as the previous note until the wi … (UAT TC-13; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-94699 table (Encounter, note)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7 Day-2 reopen (Hospital, 20 h): vitals, labs, imaging, medications and open tasks are still on the chart, each showing the date it was recorded. … (UAT TC-13; UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7; TFA-94699 AC 3; TFA-94699 table (Active med rows)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U12 A one-line summary from today's finished note appears in tomorrow's pre-round with no upload, paste or photo step. It contains nothing the note did not say and appears on that patient only. (UAT TC-13; UAT 3.4; TFA-92591 AC 5; TFA-92591 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Hospital patient A, day 1: a prior note pasted and extracted, pre-round saved with vitals and labs, three Important Points, an encounter dictated, a note generated with a one-line summary, one open task, one active and one held medication. A second Hospital patient B on the same list has no note

When Age every timestamp of A's chart by 20 h on the server, reopen A, then open B's Pre-Round

Then On A: the pre-round box is empty and the Important Points are gone. Yesterday's encounter and note are gone from Encounter / Post-Round; the encounter is listed as yesterday's transcript, and the note text can be viewed read-only as the previous note. Vitals, labs, imaging, medications and the open task are still on the chart, each with its recorded date. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-13 day-2 bullets + 3.6 (note kept as the previous note; active rows 'not mentioned today' from 18 h) + 3.7 + TFA-94699 table / AC 1 / AC 3 + TFA-92591 AC 5. U6 is judged: yesterday's note text must be viewable read-only at 20 h. Main clears it at 18 h and keeps only the summary, so a Fail is expected. …

Where it ran: dev; test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (manual)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
